defectStep: SubscriptionPricing95 (parentStep ListContainer93, filter ListOperation94 SellingModelType IN ('TermDefined','Evergreen')) -- the TermDefined ProrationMultiplier(=PricingTermCount) multiply that writes TotalLineAmount does not prorate clean list-priced TermDefined mid-term lines (TotalLineAmount and NetTotalPrice both come out full). proposedFix: Restore a TermDefined net-proration apply equivalent to the Evergreen leg: have the TermDefined SubscriptionPricing leg (or a parallel formula) multiply NetUnitPrice/ItemNetTotalPrice by PricingTermCount so NetTotalPrice reflects the fractional term, and ensure it fires for list-priced (non-discounted) TermDefined lines, not only those routed through the discount/adjustment path. Re-test on a clean UI 'Add Products' mid-term TermDefined line (no extra discount) and assert NetTotalPrice = List*Qty*PTC.
